payload.text: Final implementation: deterministic authored Mediterranean house with ivory stucco shell and real window openings, individually instanced curved terracotta tiles and ridge caps, chimney vents, recessed glazed windows, porch posts and paneled door, gutters, lantern, irregular flagstone paths, stone boundary and pillars, mailbox, wooden gate, olive trees, cypresses, shrubs, flowers and grass. Curved asphalt road has segmented curbs and broken white markings. Blue hatchback has contoured coachwork, wheel cutouts, four detailed tires and alloy wheels, interior seats, dashboard, glazing, lights, grille, trim, mirrors and antenna. Uses Three.js 0.186.1 native WebGPURenderer with forceWebGL:false, ACES exposure 1, four-sample MSAA, sun shadows and hemisphere fill. Harness controls all rendering; no animation loop or application server remains. inspectGeometry traverses actual scene geometry and exports owned position/index/normal arrays and complete world and instance matrices. pnpm run build succeeded. All three permitted recorded previews completed successfully, including numeric geometry preflight. Final small car-position, sky-color, hill-winding and path-mortar adjustments were built after the last preview. Limitations: stylized procedural foliage and simplified hatchback surfaces; distant landscape is intentionally sparse and materials do not attempt full photorealism.
